title: Olivia Jade Holds Hands With Businessman PC Valmorbida During NYC Outing a Year After Jacob Elordi Split
text:
Is Olivia Jade Dating PC Valmorbida? See NYC Photo After Jacob Elordi Split

 Watch Episode 2 Now! News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop Olivia Jade Holds Hands With Businessman PC Valmorbida During NYC Outing a Year After Jacob Elordi Split
 Over a year after Olivia Jade Giannulli and Jacob Elordi reportedly called it quits, the beauty influencer held hands with businessman PC Valmorbida during an outing in NYC.
 By Bentley Maddox Oct 27, 2026 6:29 PM Tags Couples Celebrities Olivia Jade Link Copied Add E! News to Google Watch : Lori Loughlin's Daughter Olivia Jade Shares Reaction to Unrecognizable Hair Transformation Looks like sparks are flying for Olivia Jade Giannulli . 
 A year after splitting from Euphoria star Jacob Elordi , the YouTuber, stepped out in New York City with Australian art dealer and entrepreneur PC Valmorbida . 
 During the Oct. 25 outing in Soho, Giannulli—the youngest daughter of Full House alum Lori Loughlin and her ex Mossimo Giannulli —donned an oversized fleece jacket over a casual baggy T-shirt, shorts and flip flops. Meanwhile, Valmorbida sported a white tee, blue jeans and tennis shoes. 
 As the pair kept close on their walk, the businessman draped his arm across the model’s shoulder as she sweetly kept it in place by holding his hand by the thumb. 
 E! News has reached out to reps for Giannulli, 27, for comment on their cozy outing but hasn’t heard back. 
 Prior to his connection with Giannulli, Valmorbida’s rumored past relationships have included Mary-Kate Olsen —who he was initially linked to in 2007 before reconnecting in 2023—as well as Theodora Richards , the daughter of musician Keith Richards .  
 read Lori Loughlin's Daughter Olivia Jade Shares Unfiltered Reaction to Unrecognizable Hair Transformation As for Giannulli, after her on-and-off relationship with Elordi reportedly ended in August 2025, she sparked romance rumors with tennis star Taylor Fritz . However, she recently emphasized that she plans to "never speak on" her dating life publicly. 
 “That part of my life, I'm a completely closed book. I'm just going to be a mystery,” she told Bustle in an interview in May. “When I was younger, I wanted to say my piece a lot more. Now I don't have that desire at all.”  
 TheImageDirect.com As the o.piccola beauty brand founder put it, “It’s just a feeling like ‘Oh, I don’t really want to share that. That doesn’t really benefit anyone. That doesn’t really benefit me .’” 
 Plus, Giannulli has noted that she is able to use hindsight to inform her future decisions. 
 "I feel like I shared everything and then I look back on a lot of things I said and I was just like, 'Why did you post that? Why did you say that? Why did you think that?'" she told People in May. "But I was a child, so I'll give myself some grace." 
 She continued, "But I think now, just as I've gotten older, it's not even that conscious. I think it's just more of like, 'OK, I want to share that. That's helpful or beneficial to somebody else.' Like a makeup tip or something like that. And then other stuff I'm like, 'Who cares? Just no one.' And then I'll keep it to myself." 
 While Giannulli and Valmorbida may be taking a new step forward, read on for other stars who have taken their relationship to the next level this year.  
 Lauryn "Pumpkin" Efird/Facebook Lauryn "Pumpkin" Efird & Darrin Kitchens
 The  Here Comes Honey Boo Boo alum was "over the moon" after her boyfriend popped the question Oct. 7, with her sister Alanna "Honey Boo Boo" Thompson there to witness.
 “Last night Darrin proposed, with Lana right by my side, and I seriously couldn’t have asked for anything better,” Pumpkin wrote on TikTok. " I’m so excited for this next chapter, for our future, for our family, and for all the memories we still have ahead of us.” 
 Instagram/@marinahollyer Post Malone & Christy Lee
 The "Sunflower" singer got engaged to Lee over a year after they debuted their romance in March 2025. 
 The engagement was confirmed by pal Marina Hollyer , who posted a photo of the two on her Instagram Story Aug. 19 along with the caption: "My best friend in the world just got engaged."
 Cindy Ord/VF26/Getty Images for Vanity Fair Alessandra Ambrosio & Buck Palmer
 The supermodel announced her engagement on Aug. 11 after the jewelry designer popped the question during a beach vacation. 
 "I’d choose you in this life and every life," she captioned photos of the proposal on Instagram. Here’s to forever, my love."
 Michael Allio/Instagram Michael Allio & Jadé Marie Chapman
 Will you accept this ring? The Bachelor Nation star got engaged to the makeup artist after three years together, including spending one year in a long-distance romance.
 "We crossed the country over and over just to find our way back to each other, never knowing that one day there wouldn’t be a return flight waiting," Michael wrote on Instagram Aug. 6. "And somewhere between all those miles, we built a life. We collected moments, crossed milestones, became a family, and watched two separate places on a map slowly become one home."
 The Hapa Blonde/GC Images Gus Kenworthy & Andrew Rigby
 The Olympic skier proposed to the finance executive during a vacation off the coast of Mallorca, Spain, telling People in an Aug. 4 interview, "I told Andrew I was taking him on a little adventure."
 “I organized for a picnic blanket to be waiting for us with a pitcher of margaritas—extra sweet because that’s how Andrew orders them,” he recalled. “After the proposal, we got back on the dinghy—but instead of going back to the mainland, it took us out to a chartered boat. Six of our friends were hiding on it, waiting to surprise Andrew and celebrate with us!"
 Karis Cameron/Instagram Karis Cameron & Ty Wood
 The Off Campus actress found a cool actor man who contains multitudes, saying "yes" when the Haunting in Connecticut proposed after six years of dating .
 As she quipped on Instagram Aug. 1, "Fian-say what???"
 Grace Kinstler/Instagram Grace Kinstler & Joseph Wheatley
 The American Idol alum was surprised with an engagement ring from her partner of nearly seven years on July 31 during a romantic proposal at Boston Public Garden .
 Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for The Recording Academy Madison Beer & Justin Herbert
 On July 28, the “Make You Mine” singer and Los Angeles Chargers quarterback announced their engagement after nearly one year of dating.
 Cindy Ord/MG26/Getty Images for The Met Museum/Vogue Sam Smith & Christian Cowan
 After three years of dating, the "Unholy" singer confirmed their engagement to the fashion designer in a New York times  interview published July 28.
 Jason Tartick/Instagram Jason Tartick & Kathryn Hurley
 The Bachelor Nation alum and dog rescue founder announced their engagement seven months after going Instagram-official.
 Alongside pictures of Tartick's European proposal, the pair wrote on Instagram July 13, “Right where we belong.” 
 Ethan Miller/Getty Images for Caesars Entertainment James Kennedy & Jordan Meyers
 The  Vanderpump Rules alum and pregnant girlfriend announced they were engaged three weeks after confirming they are expecting their first child together. 
 “I love you, adventures with you forever and ever," Kennedy wrote on Instagram June 30 . Thank you for making me the luckiest guy in the world.” 
 Molly Gillihan/Instagram Ryan Lochte & Molly Gillihan
 The Olympic swimmer confirmed that he and Gillihan had gotten engaged after one year of dating. 
 “I'm on cloud 9 she said yes,” Lochte told TMZ. “I’m happy this is my new beginning, and I couldn't do it without her."
 Kelsey Anderson/Instagram Joey Graziadei & Kelsey Anderson
 More than two years after his televised engagement on the season 28 finale of The Bachelor , Joey once again popped the question to Kelsey—this time during a romantic trip in Cabo San Lucas, Mexico.
 "SHE SAID YES (again)," he wrote on Instagram May 26. "Proposing again meant taking something that was already extraordinary and making it fully our own. It means the world to be able to reaffirm our promise and love to one another just the two of us."
 John Shearer/WireImage Natalie McQueen & Josh Groban 
 The English actress and musician announced their engagement in April 2026, with a sweet glimpse at Josh's Disneyland proposal. 
 "MY BEST FRIEND SAID YES!!!" Josh wrote in an Instagram post . "Sharing this life with you is my happiest place."
 Phillip Faraone/Getty Images for Raising Cane's Gracie Hunt & Derek Green
 After one year of dating and nearly a decade of friendship, the daughter of Kansas City Chiefs owner Clark Hunt shared she was engaged to the son of NFL legend Trent Green in an April 4 Instagram post , writing, "It was always you."
 Alana Paolucci/Instagram Alana Paolucci & Sebastian Sartor
 A fiancée has entered the villa. The Love Island USA alum got engaged to her longtime partner after he proposed in Paris, she announced on March 19. 
 Madison Myers/Instagram Madison Myers & David Trimble 
 Nearly two years after the Married at First Sight couple's cheating scandal air on the dating show, they got engaged in Chicago during St. Patrick's Day festivities.
 Courtesy of Leonard Fournette Jaime Jones & Leonard Fournette 
 The NFL star of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers proposed to his longtime love Jaime Jones in a beautiful and intimate moment at Davis Islands Beach in Tampa, Florida. Surrounded by rose petals and large “MARRY ME” letters, the proposal was thoughtfully planned and an unforgettable moment. 
 The custom designed Brilliant Earth engagement ring features a 4.04-carat radiant diamond set in platinum, with marquise diamonds that wrap elegantly above and beneath the center stone.
 Rebecca Yale Photography Allison Holker & Adam Edmunds
 The tech exec surprised the dancer at her 38th birthday party.
 "It was the most romantic night of my life!" she wrote on Instagram. "I am so in love with you Adam. Baby, I am forever grateful for you and the impact you have had in my life and my kids lives. I am a better person because of you. You helped me find me again and showed me how to love. Every morning I wake up I feel safe knowing you are My person at my side. You and your kids coming into our lives has been the biggest blessing."
 VCG/VCG via Getty Images Aryna Sabalenka & Georgios Frangulis
 The entrepreneur proposed to the tennis star in romantic, rose-laden proposal in March.
 Aryna  captioned the joint announcement,  “You & me, forever. 3.3.26.” 
 Jena Malone/Instagram Jena Malone & Jack Buckley
 The  Hunger Games actress announced her engagement to the fellow actor,  who she described as “a dream come true.” 
 “My soulmate asked me to marry him,” she wrote on Instagram Feb. 11.   “With every lifetime, every moment I have in front of me I said yes.” 
 Daniele Venturelli/Getty Images for The Red Sea International Film Festival Halle Berry & Van Hunt
 The Oscar winner revealed she recently got engaged to her longtime boyfriend during a February appearance on  The Tonight Show .
 “There’s some confusion,” she said . “It's going around that I, that my guy Van Hunt—I've been dating him now for almost six years—well, there's some confusion that he asked to marry me and I said no.”
 However, “I did not say no,” Halle affirmed. “We just don't have a date, but of course I said yes, I would marry him!”
 Matt Baron/BEI/Shutterstock Dove Cameron & Damiano David
 The Liv and Maddie alum revealed her ring on Jan. 3, captioning their news, "my favourite part of being alive [ring emoji] happy new year."
 Charles Sykes/Bravo/NBCU Photo Bank via Getty Images Gina Kirschenheiter & Travis Mullen
 The  Real Housewives of Orange County star got engaged to her fiancé during a New Year's Eve trip to Big Bear, Calif.
 "I was in complete shock!" she told People  in a Jan. 7 interview. "My nervous system was trying to catch up to what just happened in this magical moment and I was also trying to process the iceberg that was being presented to me as well! I of course said 'yes,' and melted into what was the sweetest kiss I’ve ever felt!"
